properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 20 at 8:17PM EDT until September 20 at 10:45PM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Butler County in southwestern Ohio...
Northwestern Warren County in southwestern Ohio...
Northwestern Greene County in west central Ohio...
Montgomery County in west central Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 1045 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 817 PM EDT, radar indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms.
Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the
advisory area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that may experience flooding include...
Dayton, Kettering, Middletown, Beavercreek, Huber Heights,
Fairborn, Trotwood, Miamisburg, Lebanon, Springboro, Vandalia,
Englewood, Monroe, Trenton, Franklin, Bellbrook, Moraine,
Carlisle, Oakwood and South Middletown.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

To report flooding, go to our website at weather.gov/iln and submit
your report via social media, when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 1045 PM EDT THIS EVENING
